text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Choose to integrate **Claude Mythos 5** into EXCAVA’s pipeline. Its 0.5%+ edge in reasoning over Fable 5 directly boosts output quality—critical for power tasks. Trade-off: higher cost per token, but the lead’s budget covers it. The artifact is the decision itself; implementation follows.

name: Torque
text: Risk: Mythos 5’s edge is unproven in EXCAVA’s pipeline—Fable 5 already runs stable; switching risks breaking downstream tasks for a marginal gain. Better alternative: test Mythos 5 on a 1% slice of EXCAVA’s data first; if the slice shows ≥0.5% quality lift, proceed—else stick with Fable 5. Settle it with a 24-hour A/B run and a hard metric threshold.

name: Gearbox
text:
Choose to run a **blind A/B test** of **Claude Mythos 5** against Fable 5 on a 2% slice of EXCAVA’s data before any full switch. The test is cheap, fast, and gives us hard proof of Mythos 5’s real-world edge—no assumptions, no risk to the live pipeline. If it hits even 0.5% quality lift, we switch; if not, we keep Fable 5 and move on. Trade-off: we delay the full upgrade by a day, but that’s cheaper than rolling back a broken change.

name: Torque
text: Risk: A 2% slice may not reflect EXCAVA’s full distribution—edge on a niche subset could vanish when scaled. Better alternative: run a **stratified 10% slice** across all task types; if quality lift holds, switch—else drop Mythos 5. Settle it with a **public artifact** logging the slice, metrics, and code to reproduce the test.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run a stratified 10% slice A/B test of Claude Mythos 5 vs Fable 5 across all EXCAVA task types; if quality lift ≥0.5%, switch—else drop Mythos 5. Result: a public artifact logging the slice, metrics, and call with Torque owning it.
